dct_title_s: Philippines Central Typhoon Kalmaegi Floods: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Nov 2025
dct_description_sm: # Philippines Central Typhoon Kalmaegi Floods: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Nov 2025 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage and flood proxy maps for Philippines Central Typhoon Kalmaegi Floods (Nov 2025) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Central, Philippines, Floods, 04 Nov 2025, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Central, Philippines, Floods, 04 Nov 2025, v0.9** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** leaflet/EOS-RS_202511_Philippines_Central_Typhoon_Kalmaegi_Floods **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2025)
